Jules Martin: quick thread  how should Console surface automatic fallback decisions during rollouts? thinking a small compact row with a chevron to open an "evidence bundle".

Harper Singh: compact row = [mode] [short reason] [sampled X/Y]. evidence bundle shows sampled events + sampling policy. don't show bodies by default.

Diego Alvarez: agree. also surface both the user-friendly reason and the raw buckets (503: 120, timeout: 18). operators cross-check the mapping.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout r-20260502-03 auto-fallback -> mode: soft_degrade, computed_reason: high_503_rate, sampled: 10/1000

Jules Martin: API sketch: /rollouts/:id/audit returns {computed_reason, raw_reasons[], sampled_fraction, sampling_meta, sampled_event_ids}. keep sampled_event_ids pointers 30d, redact payloads.

Harper Singh: ui microcopy idea: "Switched to fallback due to elevated 503 errors  1% sampled." short and human. add an info tooltip about sampling and retention.

Diego Alvarez: next steps: I'll prototype schema + a small migration to store computed_summary at write-time. Harper, can you mock the compact row + evidence bundle?

Jules Martin: perfect. I'll file the tiny RFC with privacy checklist (redaction, 30d retention, IAM gating for raw).
